title: HB912 (2024 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): (c) Any lawfully acquired rifle or shotgun may be lent to an adult who is twenty-one years of age or older for use for a period not to exceed twelve hours; provided that the adult borrowing a rifle or shotgun possesses a permit pursuant to section 134-2 or owns or possesses a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, and is not prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm pursuant to section 134-7.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): (d) No person shall knowingly lend a firearm to any person who does not have a permit pursuant to section 134-2, does not own or possess a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, or is prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm under section 134-7.
